{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the cleaned data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove QA orders
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == '999,999.99'
sales_clean = sales[~qa_mask].copy()

# Check the channel distribution
print("Channel distribution:")
print(sales_clean['channel'].value_counts())

# Check the customer_segment distribution by channel
print("\nCustomer segment distribution by channel:")
print(pd.crosstab(sales_clean['channel'], sales_clean['customer_segment']))

# Check if the groups are comparable
print("\nConversion rate by channel:")
print(sales_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean())"}
